title: PELDRUN Skill Manifest
description: Schema for manifest.json inside a PELDRUN skill package. Every skill MUST ship a manifest.json that passes this schema before it can be installed, activated, or assigned. Aligned with the PELDRUN tool manifest conventions (see backend/omweb/tools/builtins/browser_interactive.json) for identity, authoring, and settings metadata.

schema_version.description: Manifest schema version (semver). Major version MUST be 1.

id.description: Skill identifier: lowercase, 3-64 chars, [a-z0-9_]. The first character may be a letter OR a digit (e.g. '123_skill'). PELDRUN normalizes incoming IDs at install time (hyphens -> underscores, dots -> underscores, invalid chars stripped), so authors MAY use forms like 'code-review' or '123-skill' in the source repository.

name.description: Human-readable display name shown in the UI (store card, / menu).

display_name.description: Optional override for the visible name; falls back to `name` when omitted.

description.description: Short one-line summary used by the / mention menu and the store card. Keep this under ~120 chars for best UI rendering.

short_description.description: Optional shortened variant; when omitted, `description` is used.

store_description.description: Longer description shown inside the skill's details drawer. Markdown allowed.

usage_notes.description: Free-form guidance for users (e.g. 'Invoke after uploading a file'). Shown in the details drawer; not injected into the prompt.

icon.description: Optional relative path to an SVG icon inside the skill package (e.g. 'icons/code_review.svg'). MUST live inside the package; absolute paths and '..' segments are rejected. Served via GET /api/skills/{id}/icon.svg.

icon_svg.description: Optional inline SVG markup (max 32 KiB). Sanitized server-side at load time — <script>, event handlers (on*), javascript:/data: schemes, <foreignObject>, external <use>/<image> references, and <style>/@import are stripped. When both icon_svg and icon are present, icon_svg wins.

trust.description: Trust tier shown in the UI. Only 'verified' skills receive the shield badge.

signature.description: Optional content signature for tamper detection. Currently recorded but not enforced; reserved for future supply-chain verification.

screenshots.description: Optional list of relative paths or URLs pointing at preview screenshots.

stability.description: Lifecycle stability tier. Skills in 'deprecated' state remain loadable but are hidden from the / menu.

supported_languages.description: ISO 639-1 language codes this skill's instructions are authored in.

i18n.description: Optional per-language overrides keyed by ISO 639-1 code. Missing keys fall back to the top-level fields.

peldrun_min_version.description: Minimum PELDRUN version required by this skill.

peldrun_max_version.description: Maximum PELDRUN version supported (inclusive). Omit for open-ended.

chat_invocable.description: Skill can be invoked via /<skill-id> from the chat composer.

agent_assignable.description: Skill can be assigned to an agent; its instructions are then injected into every agent run for that agent.

workflow_node.description: Reserved for future Workflow engine integration. This is a declaration of intent only: it does NOT enable any runtime behavior in the current release.

type.description: Execution strategy. The current release supports ONLY 'instructions' — the SKILL.md body is injected verbatim as additional system prompt text. Custom handlers (handler.py) are not executed in this phase.

instructions_file.description: Relative path (within the skill package) to the instructions markdown file. Must not contain directory separators; the instructions file MUST live at the skill package root.

references_dir.description: Optional relative directory at the skill root that holds on-demand reference files. Nested traversal is rejected.

max_instructions_bytes.description: Hard cap on the size of the instructions file when injected into the prompt. Oversized skills are rejected at load time. Defaults to 256 KiB.

id.description: Sub-skill identifier. MUST be unique within the parent skill.

description.description: What this sub-skill does AND when to use it. Consumed by the router prompt and by BM25 ranking.

triggers.description: Optional keywords for BM25 routing. Falls back to 'description' when omitted.

instructions_file.description: Relative path (within the parent package) to the sub-skill's SKILL.md. MUST start with 'sub_skills/' and end with '.md'. Nested folders are allowed (e.g. 'sub_skills/root_cause_tracing/SKILL.md').

exclusive.description: When true, this sub-skill MUST be the only one loaded at a time within the parent skill.

user_editable.description: When true, the operator can edit SKILL.md through the Store UI. Set false for skills shipped as built-ins or governed packages. Built-in skills (is_builtin=true) are always treated as non-editable regardless of this value. Omitted means true (backward compatibility with pre-2026 skill packages).

schema.description: JSON Schema describing user-configurable settings for this skill. Mirrors the tool manifest's settings.schema. When absent, the skill exposes no user settings.

defaults.description: Default values applied when a user has not saved any override.

invocation.description: How the user triggers this skill, e.g. '/code_review' or 'assign to code_architect'.

context.description: Scenario or preconditions for the example.

expected_outcome.description: Short summary of the expected behavior/output.

replaced_by.description: Skill ID that supersedes this one (used with `deprecated: true`).
